tools.name: list_files
tools.description: Lists the CSV, TSV, Parquet, JSON Lines and Excel files that vastgrid may open, in the allowed folders (/pkg), up to two folders deep.

tools.name: open_grid
tools.description: Opens a CSV, TSV, Parquet, JSON Lines or Excel file of the allowed folders in a grid that the person sees and works in. Files of any size open: DuckDB reads them on the server. Gives the grid's id, its columns and its state. `document` (§5.1 of the vastgrid 0.2 specification) sets the view to start with: its plan (filters, sort, groups, derived columns) and its columns (widths, pins, formats).

file.description: The file: a path, absolute or in the first allowed folder.

sheet.description: The sheet of an Excel workbook.

document.description: A document of the specification (§5.1): { kind: 'vastgrid/document', version: 2, plan?, columns? }.

tools.name: grid_state
tools.description: Reads the state of a grid as the person sees it now: the document (§5.1: plan and columns), the session (§5.2: active cell, selection, checked rows, editor, undo history), the displayed columns, the row count of the view and the unsaved edits.

tools.name: grid_rows
tools.description: Reads rows of the grid's view (its filters, sort and groups applied, edits included) as JSON values: big integers, decimals, dates and times as strings. Strings are cut to 1,000 code points (truncated lists the offsets). At most 500 rows at once; columns are the displayed ones by default.

tools.name: grid_command
tools.description: Applies a command of the vastgrid 0.2 specification (§6) to a grid, as the person's keys and menus do: the person sees the result at once. A command is { command, …arguments }, for example { "command": "sort.set", "keys": [{ "column": "price", "direction": "desc" }] }, { "command": "filter.column", "column": "region", "where": { "fn": "eq", "args": [{ "col": "region" }, { "lit": "EU" }] } }, { "command": "select", "row": 0, "column": "price" } then { "command": "edit.begin", "text": "12.50" } and { "command": "edit.commit" } to write a cell. Commands: sort.set, sort.toggle, sort.clear, filter.set, filter.column, filter.clear, search.set, derive.add, derive.update, derive.remove, group.set, group.clear, having.set, column.resize, column.move, column.hide, column.show, column.pin, column.format, column.total, select, select.rows, select.columns, select.all, move, move.home, move.end, advance, scroll.to, check, uncheck, check.all, check.clear, detail.open, detail.close, edit.begin, edit.change, edit.cancel, edit.commit, edit.clear, edit.paste, edit.fill, history.undo, history.redo, copy, export, save, history.clear. A command that fails changes nothing and tells why (invalid_command with a reason and a path into the command).

tools.name: vastgrid_message
tools.description: Carries a request of the vastgrid 0.2 specification (§8) from the App to the engine.

tools.name: grid_sync
tools.description: Keeps the App's document and session in step with the grid's: gives the person's changes and waits for the agent's, and for the engine's events of the App's tables.
